subject: Contradictions in a reconstructed history might concern receipt dates, quantities, or which purchase supplied the product being discussed.
rationale: S003 supports contradictions as possible failures of documentary consistency and item linkage. In the order-and-product setting described by T001, dates, quantities and purchase identity are reasonable illustrative dimensions of disagreement. The assertion claims only possible discrepancy types, without asserting any observed contradiction, prevalence or cause of nonpurchase.
